proposal.name: Show how proposals cover listed mistakes

plan.name: Show how proposals cover listed mistakes
plan.summary: Modeled drafting, including amendments, existing-code checks and option previews, will transcribe every mistake the issue lists in its original words and order into an optional mistakes array in proposal.json, with says and either bugs naming one or more bug statements or a nonblank reason for planting none; the prompt will require planting each bug in the step and at the moment described, while keeping today's guidance when no mistakes are listed. Shared validation in drafting checks, independent final checks and saved-proposal validation will reject blank mistake text, entries with neither bugs nor a reason or with both, and blank, repeated, undefined or non-bug references, identifying the offending entry and reference so the agent can repair them. Ordinary and compact proposal, amendment and modeled-option comments will show every entry beside its bugs or explicit omission reason as literal-safe, indispensable text under the existing publication limits, and saved results, markers and revision inputs will retain the complete record. This is explanatory proposal metadata: existing statement hashes, ratified locks, proof checks and proposals without the field keep their behavior, and checking the record does not claim to parse every issue or prove that a bug models the listed mistake faithfully; the ratifier still compares the transcribed list and the modeled steps with the issue. Update SPEC.md with a bullet citing [#947's ratified plan](.invariant/plans/issue-947.json), add a brief README explanation within its 400-line limit, and document the schema, examples, validation, display and human completeness check in docs/factory.md, extending the existing draft-validation and comment regressions without weakening their legacy guarantees.

tests.name: TestMistakeDraftingInstructions947
tests.says: New drafts, amendments and existing-code drafts are instructed to account for each listed mistake, plant it at the described step and moment, and explain omissions.

tests.name: TestMistakeRecordValidation947
tests.says: Every recorded mistake has literal text and exactly one disposition, and every bug reference names a distinct bug statement; refusals identify the bad entry and reference.

tests.name: TestMistakeRecordRoundTrip947
tests.says: The ordered mistake record retains exact wording, multiple bug references and omission reasons through proposal serialization without changing statement identities or legacy drafts.

tests.name: TestMistakeCheckAndFinalValidation947
tests.says: The drafting check and independent final check reject incomplete mistake records, accept repaired explanations, and retain them in saved results and revision inputs.

tests.name: TestMistakePreviewValidation947
tests.says: Each modeled option validates its own mistake record, reports its fork and option on refusal, and preserves a repaired record through checked preview export.

tests.name: TestMistakeProposalComments947
tests.says: Ordinary and compact proposals, amendments and modeled-option comments visibly pair every mistake with its bugs or omission reason, escape literal text, and refuse to truncate oversized coverage.

tests.name: TestMistakeSavedProposal947
tests.says: Inline markers and saved-draft references preserve mistake records, and saved proposals with invalid coverage are refused even when their payload digest matches.

usage.summary: Wrote [plan.json](/var/folders/fz/s3p17rl97r30y73d180fjbmc0000gn/T/invariant-plan-464715849/plan.json) and seven acceptance tests covering mistake records, validation, display, and persistence. The check passed: all seven fail on the unchanged base, and the resulting PR requires a person to merge.
